images.filename: Plaza During Bicycle Races 1901 Bacolod, Western Negros.jpg
images.caption: Bacolod Public Plaza during bicycle races in 1901, Municipality of Bacolod, Western Negros, United States Territory (presently: City of Bacolod, Negros Occidental, Philippines). The "bicycles" are actually two-wheeled single horse-drawn carriages. In the Philippines, it is known  as calesa () or carretela ().
images.alt: Bacolod Public Plaza during bicycle races in 1901, Municipality of Bacolod, Western Negros, United States Territory (presently: City of Bacolod, Negros Occidental, Philippines). The "bicycles" are actually two-wheeled single horse-drawn carriages. In the Philippines, it is known  as calesa () or carretela ().
